objects.description: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) used a backdoor, NESTEGG, that has the capability to download and upload files to and from a victim’s machine.(Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018) Additionally, [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has downloaded other payloads onto a victim’s machine.(Citation: 1 - appv)
objects.description_fa: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) از یک درب پشتی، NESTEGG، استفاده می‌کرد که قابلیت دانلود و آپلود فایل‌ها را به و از دستگاه قربانی دارد. ماشین.(Citation: 1 - appv) (Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018)
